_comment: Single source of truth for OrbitLab central-body physical constants and GMAT mapping. Keys are the API centralBody names. Earth/Moon/Mars values are the frozen legacy constants and MUST NOT change. New-body radii are SPICE 2015 IAU. mu from GMAT-installed files / IAU-JPL standard (see phase3_ai_interpreter/body_expansion/mu_readback.*). soiRadiusKm = sphere-of-influence radius (km) recomputed on 2026-01-01 12:00 UTCGregorian from GMAT epoch distance d * (mu_body/mu_parent)^(2/5), see phase3_ai_interpreter/closeout2/soi_check.md; null for the Sun (heliocentric reference, no enclosing parent, no SOI restriction).

Earth.radiusConvention: Earth: legacy equatorial radius (WGS-84 / GMAT EGM-96 reference ellipsoid)
Earth.muSource: GMAT data\gravity\earth\EGM96.cof l.7 POTFIELD 3.98600441500E+14 m3/s2 (== frozen legacy value)
Earth.muNotes: Read-back probe R=7073 km -> mu=398600.4415 (rel. -1.17e-10%, machine-exact). Legacy Earth mu 398600.4415 KEPT.

Moon.muSource: Frozen legacy value; GMAT data\gravity\luna\LP165P.cof l.7 POTFIELD 4.90280105600e+12 m3/s2 (=4902.801056) differs by +2e-5%
Moon.muNotes: Read-back probe R=2000 km -> mu=4902.800582. Legacy Moon mu 4902.800066 KEPT per requirement.

Mars.muSource: Frozen legacy value; GMAT data\gravity\mars\Mars50c.cof l.7 POTFIELD 4.28283703710e+13 m3/s2 (=42828.370371) differs by -1.1e-5%
Mars.muNotes: Read-back probe R=3789.5 km -> mu=42828.314258. Legacy Mars mu 42828.375214 KEPT per requirement.

Mercury.radiusConvention: Mercury: SPICE 2015 IAU mean radius (2440.53 km)
Mercury.muNotes: GMAT point-mass circular-orbit probe R=3600 km read back mu=22032.080486 (GMAT's internal Mercury parameter; no gravity .cof in GMAT install, no DE405 entry, CelestialBody.Mu set-only).

Venus.radiusConvention: Venus: SPICE 2015 IAU mean radius (6051.8 km)
Venus.muNotes: GMAT point-mass circular-orbit probe R=7000 km read back mu=324858.598827 (GMAT MGNP180U.cof l.7 POTFIELD 3.24858592079000e+14 m3/s2).

Jupiter.muNotes: GMAT point-mass circular-orbit probe R=74000 km read back mu=126712767.857614 (point-mass only, no gravity file).

Sun.muNotes: GMAT point-mass circular-orbit probe R=AU read back mu=132712440017.746521. Heliocentric (Sun-centred) orbits use point-mass Sun. AU=149597870.691 km.
